recordTitle: Record — record into the arrangement. Select a MIDI part of the set: Record records what you play on it. The Torus was set again as Tide pad keeps it, except: L5′ is already acting; CF7 is already act

niSession.key: Press a key: it strikes the sky's voices nearest that note. The body then rings by its own damping.
niSession.janko-note: Live. Keys that are paler have no voice in this sky.
niSession.janko-standing: declared-instrument-mapping: a played key sounds the scene voices whose own just-ratio pitch is nearest the key's chromatic class over C3; the sources define the voices' pitches and the surface's classes and define no routing between them,
